zh: 这些年，你们为它接上了水。
en: Over the years, you brought water to it.

zh: 水管接好啦！小叶子再也不会渴了！
en: The pipe's connected! Little leaf will never be thirsty again!

zh: 小镇一年比一年大，机器人走得越来越远。
en: The town grew bigger every year, and the robots went farther and farther.

zh: 再往前一点点……那边还有一整条街呢！
en: A little farther... there's a whole street over there!

zh: {girl}开始自己画图纸，有时也会和你争该先修哪里。
en: {girl} started drawing her own blueprints, and sometimes argued with you about what to fix first.

zh: 这次听我的嘛，先把路修通，机器人才好跑。
en: Listen to me this time. Fix the road first so the robots can get around.

zh: 那株植物，长成了一小片绿地。
en: That plant grew into a small patch of green.

zh: 那株植物：长成了一小片绿地
en: The plant: grew into a small patch of green

zh: 施工机器人：3 台，每周工作单位 9
en: Construction robots: 3, 9 work units per week

zh: 第 3 台施工机器人已修复（这些年，{girl}学会了修它）
en: 3rd construction robot repaired (over these years, {girl} learned how)
